title: Unit 4 第一课时 基础达标与综合拓展

sections.title: I. 语音练习
sections.instruction: 语音练习，将下列单词按画线部分的发音归类，选出正确的一组单词。

questions.prompt: 1. 画线字母发 /æ/ 的单词是：
questions.translation: 画线字母发 /æ/ 的单词是：math
questions.explanation: m<u>a</u>th 中 a 发 /æ/；f<u>a</u>vourite 中 a 发 /eɪ/；bec<u>au</u>se 中 au 发 /ɔː/；ge<u>o</u>graphy 中 o 发 /ɒ/。故选 math。

questions.prompt: 2. 画线字母组合发 /ɔː/ 的单词是：
questions.translation: 画线字母组合发 /ɔː/ 的单词是：because
questions.explanation: bec<u>au</u>se 中的 au 发 /ɔː/。故选 because。

questions.prompt: 3. 画线字母发 /ɪ/ 的单词是：
questions.translation: 画线字母发 /ɪ/ 的单词是：Chinese
questions.explanation: Ch<u>i</u>nese 中 i 发 /ɪ/；sc<u>i</u>ence 中 i 发 /aɪ/；wh<u>y</u> 中 y 发 /aɪ/。故选 Chinese。

questions.prompt: 4. 画线字母发 /ɒ/ 的单词是：
questions.translation: 画线字母发 /ɒ/ 的单词是：geography
questions.explanation: ge<u>o</u>graphy 中的 o 发 /ɒ/。故选 geography。

questions.prompt: 5. 画线字母发 /aɪ/ 的单词是：
questions.translation: 画线字母发 /aɪ/ 的单词是：science, why
questions.explanation: sc<u>i</u>ence 中的 i 和 wh<u>y</u> 中的 y 均发双元音 /aɪ/。故选 science, why。

sections.title: II. 用所给词的适当形式填空
sections.instruction: 用所给词的适当形式填空
sections.passage:
1. It's [1] (interest) to listen to music.
2. I think it is [2] (bore), so I don't like it.
3. Biology and math are our favourite [3] (subject).
4. I love science best, because it's [4] (use).
5. I am a [5] (China), so I am good at [6] (China).
6. Do you believe a cat has nine [7] (life)?
7. These questions are difficult, but he can answer them [8] (easy).
8. Work makes me [9] (tire).
9. We have four [10] (class) in the morning this term.
10. Do you have any [11] (problem)?
11. She loves all her students but Ann and Tom are her [12] (favourite).
12. I have a lot of subjects every day, and I think they are very [13] (help). So I learn them very hard.
13. I like P.E., because it's [14] (excite).

questions.translation: 听音乐很有趣。
questions.explanation: It's + adj. + to do sth. 句型中，修饰“听音乐”这件事用 -ing 结尾的形容词 interesting，意为“有趣的”。故选 interesting。

questions.translation: 我觉得它很无聊，所以我不喜欢它。
questions.explanation: 主语 it 指代事物，作表语用修饰物的形容词 boring，意为“无聊的”。故选 boring。

questions.translation: 生物和数学是我们最喜欢的学科。
questions.explanation: 主语 Biology and math 是两门学科，谓语为 are，因此 subject 应用复数形式 subjects。故选 subjects。

questions.translation: 我最喜欢科学，因为它很有用。
questions.explanation: 系动词 is 后接形容词作表语，use 的形容词形式是 useful，意为“有用的”。故选 useful。

questions.translation: 我是一个中国人，所以我擅长中文。
questions.explanation: a Chinese 表示“一个中国人”；Chinese 单复数同形。故选 Chinese。

questions.translation: 所以我擅长中文。
questions.explanation: be good at 后面接学科或语言名词 Chinese（中文/语文）。故选 Chinese。

questions.translation: 你相信猫有九条命吗？
questions.explanation: nine 后接可数名词复数，life 以 fe 结尾，变复数将 fe 改为 ves，即 lives。故选 lives。

questions.translation: 这些问题很难，但他能很容易地回答它们。
questions.explanation: 修饰动词 answer 需要用副词 easily，意为“容易地”。故选 easily。

questions.translation: 工作让我感到劳累。
questions.explanation: make sb. + adj. 表示“使某人……”，宾语 me 指人，感到疲倦用形容词 tired。故选 tired。

questions.translation: 这学期我们上午有四节课。
questions.explanation: 基数词 four 后接可数名词复数 classes。故选 classes。

questions.translation: 你有什么问题/疑难吗？
questions.explanation: any 在疑问句中修饰可数名词复数 problems。故选 problems。

questions.translation: 她爱她所有的学生，但安和汤姆是她最喜欢的人。
questions.explanation: favourite 作名词表示“特别喜爱的人或物”，此处作 are 的表语且指代两个人 Ann and Tom，用复数 favourites。故选 favourites。

questions.translation: 我每天有很多科目，我觉得它们非常有帮助。
questions.explanation: are very 后接形容词作表语，help 的形容词为 helpful，意为“有帮助的”。故选 helpful。

questions.translation: 我喜欢体育课，因为它很令人兴奋。
questions.explanation: 主语 it 指代 P.E.（体育课），形容事物令人兴奋应用 exciting。故选 exciting。

sections.title: III. 句型转换
sections.instruction: 按要求完成句子转换，选择正确的一项。

questions.prompt:
1. He likes art <u>because it's fun</u>. (对画线部分提问)
______ ______ he ______ art?
questions.translation: 他喜欢美术是因为很有趣。—— 他为什么喜欢美术？
questions.explanation: 对 because 引导的原因状语提问用疑问词 Why；主语 he 是第三人称单数，助动词用 does，后面的谓语动词还原为原形 like。故选 Why does; like。

questions.prompt:
2. <u>My favourite subject</u> is English. (对画线部分提问)
______ ______ favourite subject?
questions.translation: 我最喜欢的学科是英语。—— 你最喜欢的学科是什么？
questions.explanation: 对学科提问用 What's your favourite subject? 或 What is your favourite subject? 故选 What is your。

questions.prompt:
3. I don't think math is interesting. (改为同义句)
I ______ math is ______.
questions.translation: 我认为数学没有趣味。—— 我认为数学很无聊。
questions.explanation: not interesting 等同于 boring，“我认为数学很无聊”即 I think math is boring。故选 think; boring。

questions.prompt:
4. English is my favourite subject. (改为同义句)
I ______ English ______ of all my subjects.
questions.translation: 英语是我最喜欢的学科。—— 在所有学科中我最喜欢英语。
questions.explanation: favourite subject 等同于 like... best，“最喜欢……”用 like ... best。故选 like; best。

questions.prompt:
5. Bai Jie likes history very much. (改为一般疑问句)
______ Bai Jie ______ history very much?
questions.translation: 白洁非常喜欢历史。—— 白洁非常喜欢历史吗？
questions.explanation: 一般现在时主语 Bai Jie 是单数第三人称，变一般疑问句在句首加助动词 Does，动词 likes 还原为原形 like。故选 Does; like。

questions.prompt:
6. Sandy doesn't look smart or beautiful. (改为肯定句)
Sandy ______ ______ ______ beautiful.
questions.translation: 桑迪看起来既不聪明也不漂亮。—— 桑迪看起来聪明又漂亮。
questions.explanation: 否定句中的 or 改为肯定句时需变为 and；主语 Sandy 为单数第三人称，look 变为 looks。故选 looks smart and。

questions.prompt:
7. Linda's music teacher is <u>Miss Li</u>. (对画线部分提问)
______ ______ Linda's music teacher?
questions.translation: 琳达的音乐老师是李老师。—— 谁是琳达的音乐老师？
questions.explanation: 对人 Miss Li 提问用疑问词 Who，句首首字母大写 Who is。故选 Who is。

questions.prompt:
8. Bob likes geography. Bob likes Chinese. (合并为一句)
Bob likes ______ ______ ______.
questions.translation: 鲍勃喜欢地理。鲍勃喜欢语文。—— 鲍勃喜欢地理和语文。
questions.explanation: 肯定句中连接两个并列宾语用并列连词 and，即 geography and Chinese。故选 geography and Chinese。

questions.prompt:
9. Mike's mother doesn't work in the same office as Millie's. (同义句转换)
Mike's mother works in ______ ______ from Millie's.
questions.translation: 迈克的妈妈和米莉的妈妈不在同一间办公室工作。—— 迈克的妈妈在和米莉的妈妈不同的一间办公室工作。
questions.explanation: not in the same office as 表示“和……不在同一个办公室”，同义表达为 in a different office from（在不同的办公室），冠词用 a 修饰 different office。故选 a different office。

questions.prompt:
10. Chocolate isn't healthy. It's my favourite food. (用but连接两个句子)
________________________________________________________
options: Chocolate isn't healthy, but it's my favourite food.
Chocolate isn't healthy but it my favourite food.
Chocolate isn't healthy, but is my favourite food.
Chocolate isn't healthy, so it's my favourite food.
questions.translation: 巧克力不健康。它是我最喜欢的食物。—— 巧克力不健康，但它是我最喜欢的食物。
questions.explanation: 用连词 but 连接两个分句，表示转折关系，句意完整：Chocolate isn't healthy, but it's my favourite food. 故选 Chocolate isn't healthy, but it's my favourite food.。

sections.title: IV. 完形填空
sections.instruction: 通读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后在各题所给的四个选项中选出一个最佳答案。
sections.passage: Hi! I'm Nancy. This is my [1], Emily. She's 12 years old. Her birthday is [2] February. Here is a picture of her. Look, [3] are her eyes? Oh! They're [4]. And her hair is black, too. She is beautiful and healthy. Soccer is her favourite sport. It's [5] for her. She can [6] it very well. After school, she plays [7] with her classmates. For breakfast, she loves milk, eggs and fruit. So she has [8] eating habits. Her favourite subject is science. She says it's relaxing, [9] I think it's difficult. We like our science [10], Ms. Lin, because she is great fun.

questions.translation: 这是我的朋友艾米丽。她12岁。
questions.explanation: 根据后文“She's 12 years old.”以及她们是同学可知，艾米丽是南希的“朋友（friend）”。故选 friend。

questions.translation: 她的生日在二月。
questions.explanation: 在某个月份前介词用 in。故选 in。

questions.translation: 看，她的眼睛是什么颜色的？
questions.explanation: 询问颜色用 what colour。故选 what colour。

questions.translation: 哦！它们是黑色的。而且她的头发也是黑色的。
questions.explanation: 根据后一句“And her hair is black, too.”中的 too（也）可知，眼睛也是黑色的（black）。故选 black。

questions.translation: 足球对她来说很容易。
questions.explanation: 由后文“She can play it very well.”可知，踢足球对她来说很“容易（easy）”。故选 easy。

questions.translation: 她足球踢得非常好。
questions.explanation: 踢足球用动词 play，情态动词 can 后接动词原形 play。故选 play。

questions.translation: 放学后，她和同班同学一起踢足球。
questions.explanation: 根据上文“Soccer is her favourite sport.”可知放学后踢的是足球（soccer）。故选 soccer。

questions.translation: 所以她有着健康的饮食习惯。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词 eating habits 用形容词 healthy，意为“健康的”。故选 healthy。

questions.translation: 她说科学令人放松，但我认为它很难。
questions.explanation: 前句 relaxing 与后句 difficult 构成转折，连词用 but。故选 but。

questions.translation: 我们喜欢我们的科学老师林老师，因为她很有趣。
questions.explanation: Ms. Lin 是称呼，指“科学老师（science teacher）”。故选 teacher。

sections.title: V. 阅读理解
sections.instruction: 阅读下列短文，从每题所给的四个选项中选出最佳答案。
sections.passage:
Hi, my name is Tony. I'm a student of Confucius Institute in Chicago. My school is 15 years old. I like it very much because I can learn Chinese in it.

Chinese is difficult, but it's very useful. Now, CIC and China's five schools are sister schools. One of them is Beijing No. 4 High School. I have a pen friend from the school. His name is Liu Gang. Nick is his English name. Liu Gang's favourite subject is English. He thinks it's easy and fun.

Every year, twenty to thirty students of CIC can go to its sister schools. And the students can stay for four to six weeks there. I really want to go to China next year. And I really want to meet my Chinese pen friend.

questions.prompt: 1. What does Tony think of Chinese?
questions.translation: 托尼觉得中文怎么样？—— 难但很有用。
questions.explanation: 根据第二段第一句“Chinese is difficult, but it's very useful.”可知，托尼认为中文虽难但很有用。故选 Difficult but useful。

questions.translation: 尼克是谁？—— 托尼的笔友。
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“I have a pen friend from the school. His name is Liu Gang. Nick is his English name.”可知，尼克是托尼的笔友刘刚的英文名。故选 Tony's pen friend。

questions.prompt: 3. What subject does Liu Gang like best?
questions.translation: 刘刚最喜欢什么科目？—— 英语。
questions.explanation: 根据第二段倒数第二句“Liu Gang's favourite subject is English.”可知，刘刚最喜欢的科目是英语。故选 English。

questions.prompt: 4. From the passage, we can learn that ________
options: Tony will go to China next year
the students of CIC can stay for four to six weeks in one of CIC's sister schools
questions.translation: 从文章中我们可以了解到：芝加哥孔子学院的学生可以在其姐妹学校停留四到六周。
questions.explanation: 根据第三段第二句“And the students can stay for four to six weeks there.”可知，芝加哥孔子学院的学生可以在姐妹学校呆4-6周。故选 the students of CIC can stay for four to six weeks in one of CIC's sister schools。

sections.title: VI. 语篇填空
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，在空白处填入1个适当的单词或括号内单词的正确形式。
sections.passage:
Rock music is coming out of my computer. As a rock music [1] (love), I play the electric guitar in the school band. Sometimes I write songs [2] share them online. There is so much fun in music.

Right at this moment, the sound of Grandpa's erhu cuts in. Yes, music is also my [3] (grandpa) hobby. But it's a different kind of music. He likes playing the erhu in the park with his friends. They sing Beijing opera together. There are many [4] (fan) of them.

An idea [5] (sudden) hits me: Why don't we put our music together? I can write a song for us. "Grandpa!" I rush into [6] (he) room...

There is [7] art festival every autumn in my school. I decide [8] (take) part in it with Grandpa this year. After a week's practice, we are [9] the stage (舞台). I nod to Grandpa and we fire up our instruments. Everybody moves with our music.

Grandpa [10] (give) me a big smile, and I smile back. It feels great to enjoy our hobby together.

questions.translation: 作为一个摇滚音乐爱好者，我在学校乐队里弹电吉他。
questions.explanation: a rock music lover 表示“一名摇滚乐爱好者”，用名词单数 lover。故选 lover。

questions.translation: 有时我写歌并在网上分享它们。
questions.explanation: write songs 与 share them online 是并列顺承关系，用连词 and 连接。故选 and。

questions.translation: 是的，音乐也是我爷爷的爱好。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词 hobby 需要用名词所有格形式 grandpa's，意为“爷爷的”。故选 grandpa's。

questions.translation: 他们有很多粉丝/爱好者。
questions.explanation: many 修饰可数名词复数，fan 的复数是 fans。故选 fans。

questions.translation: 一个想法突然浮现在我脑海中：为什么我们不把音乐融合在一起呢？
questions.explanation: 修饰动词 hits 需要用副词 suddenly，意为“突然地”。故选 suddenly。

questions.translation: 我冲进他的房间……
questions.explanation: 修饰名词 room 需要用形容词性物主代词 his，意为“他的”。故选 his。

questions.translation: 每年秋天我们学校都有一个艺术节。
questions.explanation: art festival 以元音音素 /ɑː/ 开头，表示泛指“一个”，不定冠词用 an。故选 an。

questions.translation: 我决定今年和爷爷一起参加。
questions.explanation: decide to do sth. 是固定搭配，表示“决定做某事”，后接动词不定式 to take。故选 to take。

questions.translation: 经过一周的练习，我们登上了舞台。
questions.explanation: “在舞台上”固定搭配为 on the stage。故选 on。

questions.translation: 爷爷冲我灿烂地笑了笑，我也回以微笑。
questions.explanation: 文章讲述现场生动的场景，前后动词 nod, fire up, smile back 均为一般现在时，主语 Grandpa 是第三人称单数，动词用 gives。故选 gives。

sections.title: VII. (2025·德阳)阅读理解
sections.instruction: 阅读下列短文，从每题所给的四个选项中选出最佳答案。
sections.passage:
Dear students,
Get ready for a wonderful school trip! We will visit Zhongjiang Noodle Village this Saturday. It's going to be a day full of joy!

**Schedule:**

| Time | Activity |
| :--- | :--- |
| 8:30 | Arrive at your classroom. |
| 8:30-9:00 | Meet at the school gate to get on school buses. |
| 9:00-10:00 | Travel to Zhongjiang Noodle Village. |
| 10:00-11:00 | Enjoy a train ride and take photos. |
| 11:00-13:00 | Have a picnic and play games on the square. |
| 13:00-16:00 | Learn to make noodles from the villagers. |
| 16:00-16:30 | Taste the hand-made noodles. |
| 16:30-17:30 | Go back to school. |

**Notice:**
1. Wear your summer school uniform and comfortable shoes.
2. Bring your lunch box or money to buy food.
3. Bring water, a hat and any medicine you need.
4. Mobile phones are not allowed. Bring your own camera to take photos.

If you have any questions about the trip, ask your teachers for help. Have a good time on the trip!

Sunshine Middle School

questions.prompt: 1. When will students meet at the school gate to get on school buses?
questions.translation: 学生们什么时候在校门口集合上校车？—— 8:30-9:00。
questions.explanation: 根据 Schedule 表格中第二行“8:30-9:00 | Meet at the school gate to get on school buses.”可知，集合上校车的时间是 8:30-9:00。故选 8:30-9:00。

questions.prompt: 2. What can students bring according to the notice?
questions.translation: 根据须知，学生可以带什么？—— 午餐盒/饭盒。
questions.explanation: 根据 Notice 第2条“Bring your lunch box or money to buy food.”可知，学生可以带午餐盒（Lunch boxes）。第4条明确提到“Mobile phones are not allowed”。故选 Lunch boxes。

questions.prompt: 3. Which activity will take the longest time?
questions.translation: 哪项活动耗时最长？—— 向村民学习做面条。
questions.explanation: 根据表格，Having a picnic 耗时2小时（11:00-13:00）；Go back to school 耗时1小时（16:30-17:30）；Enjoy a train ride 耗时1小时（10:00-11:00）；Learn to make noodles 耗时3小时（13:00-16:00），耗时最长。故选 Learning to make noodles。
